selection_reason: Adam and AdamW with weight decay 1e-4 produced identical training and postprocessed validation results under the controlled experimental configuration. Per-frame differences in Dice, IoU, precision, recall, normalized HD95, and absolute area error were all zero. Since AdamW provided no measurable validation improvement while introducing an additional weight-decay hyperparameter, Adam was retained as the simpler optimizer configuration.
important_interpretation: This result does not establish that Adam is universally superior to AdamW. It only shows that the tested AdamW configuration (weight decay 1e-4) provided no measurable advantage in this experiment.
